name: Deploy SQL Schema

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'infra/setup-music-tables.sql'

jobs:
  deploy-schema:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Azure Login
        uses: azure/login@v1
        with:
          client-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}
      
      - name: Get SQL Server Details
        id: sql
        run: |
          SERVER_FQDN=$(az sql server show \
            --name <server-name> \
            --resource-group <rg-name> \
            --query fullyQualifiedDomainName -o tsv)
          echo "server=$SERVER_FQDN" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
      
      - name: Install sqlcmd
        run: |
          curl https://packages.microsoft.com/keys/microsoft.asc | sudo apt-key add -
          curl https://packages.microsoft.com/config/ubuntu/$(lsb_release -rs)/prod.list | \
            sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/msprod.list
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo ACCEPT_EULA=Y apt-get install -y mssql-tools18 unixodbc-dev
      
      - name: Execute SQL Script
        env:
          SQLCMDPASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SQL_ADMIN_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          /opt/mssql-tools18/bin/sqlcmd \
            -S ${{ steps.sql.outputs.server }} \
            -d grooveapp-db \
            -U sqladmin \
            -i infra/setup-music-tables.sql \
            -C  # Trust server certificate for Azure SQL
